We also claim that there exists a unique value z ′ 1 such that for z 1 > z ′ 1 there is no such MFTS with 1 switching starting at ( z 1 , 0) ∈ [0 , 1] × [0 , 1] . Similarly there is a unique z ′ 2 with analogous property for the second coordinate. Moreover, on each ray starting from (0 , 0) there is a unique point satisfying analogous property and U ˜ q has the triangular shape as in Figure 4.5. The sides of this triangle along the z 1 - and z 2 -axes are denoted I 1 and I 2 and the hypotenuse is denoted I 3 .
